hotels.title: Yarra Valley Wine Country Escape with Onsite Dining & Day Spa
hotels.description: Tucked away in the heart of Victoria's Yarra Valley, Balgownie Estate is a boutique resort made for wine lovers. The property offers an elevated experience, with gourmet dining and indulgent spa treatments just steps from your room. Restaurant 1309 serves everything from morning coffee to romantic dinners, while the cellar door showcases Balgownie's award-winning wines. At endota spa, treatments and massages are designed to leave guests refreshed and rejuvenated. Beyond the resort, the Yarra Valley invites exploration - float above the vineyards in a hot air balloon, sample local cheeses or simply unwind amid the region's serene countryside. Ideally positioned at the heart of one of Australia's most celebrated wine regions, Balgownie Estate is the perfect retreat to return to.
